messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: reserved pool 'resv-west-1' exceeding capacity. GPU util 99.8% (5m avg). Queue growth detected +12k over 10m, throttling active. Affected tenants: greenpoint-finance (reserved), blueleaf, multiple best-effort sessions. Pager triggered to oncall.

maya: oncall maya here — paging in. who has quick visibility on queue + autoscaler state? this is hitting customers. tagging sam and iona.

sam: grabbing metrics now. short snapshot:

```
$ resvctl pool status resv-west-1 --json
{
  "utilization": 0.998,
  "queued_tasks": 12345,
  "autoscaler_active": true,
  "max_nodes": 12,
  "current_nodes": 12,
  "pending_scale_up": 0
}
```

Autoscaler not scaling — reached max_nodes. also seeing large number of short-lived sessions from non-reserved tenants in this pool.

iona: confirmed — autoscaler hit configured ceiling (max_nodes=12). cloud GPU quota for account/region also at 12, so scale-up is blocked by quota. we need either quota bump or overflow routing to shared pool as a short-term mitigation.

chun: we can enable overflow routing to shared-west-1 to shed load off reserved pool (degraded perf but keeps customers online). propose policy `throttle-lowprio` so only best-effort traffic migrates.

maya: do it. prioritize keeping reserved tenants' tokens on-reserved if possible — route best-effort first. alex, prep customer comms for greenpoint.

incident-bot: ACTION: overflow routing enabled -> shared-west-1 (policy=throttle-lowprio). approx 3400 sessions rerouted. logs: route_job_id=rn-2024-06-01-1934. :white_check_mark:

sam: post-reroute quick checks:
- queue: 12345 -> 8200
- reserved GPU util down to 95% (still high)
- seeing noisy tenant `dev-sandbox` holding ~60% of active sessions on reserved pool

maya: who owns dev-sandbox? can we preempt those sessions? any chance they're mistakenly flagged reserved?

chun: dev-sandbox is labelled best_effort, not reserved. preemption policy `evict-best-effort` available. I'll start evict job targeting top noisy sessions.

chun: running command now:
```
resvctl evict --pool resv-west-1 --tag best_effort --limit 1500
```

ops-bot: evict job started: evict_job_id=ev-7890. progress: evicted=1520 sessions, reclaimed=11 GPUs, reclaimed_tokens=~440k. estimated additional capacity restored for reserved tenants: +11 GPUs. :hammer_and_wrench:

alex: customer comms: Greenpoint CS — "We're aware of degraded latency; routing some non-critical sessions to a shared pool. Impact window ~7-15 minutes. We'll monitor and update." Bridge opened w/ customer. ticket #98765 created. will escalate to AE + CSM.

sam: following evict and overflow, queue now ~3.2k and reserved utilization ~88%. tail latency spikes reduced. still want to follow up on why so many best-effort sessions landed in reserved pool.

maya: good short-term. next steps: 1) request quota bump to cloud for regional GPU quota to allow autoscaler to scale above 12, 2) adjust autoscaler to be quota-aware (don't appear blocked silently), 3) enforce per-tenant soft limits to avoid noisy neighbors. sam/iona/chun own these.

sam: logging autoscaler error snippet to include in postmortem:
```
ERROR scale_manager: scale-up blocked: quota_exceeded region=us-west-1 account=redwood-prod at manager.go:312
```

iona: filing cloud support ticket for quota bump, request reference cs-2024-456. also adding temporary runbook change to allow manual override of max_nodes during P1 capacity events.

maya: handoff to day-shift SRE happening in 30m. @sam @iona @chun continue postmortem + remediation. i'll mark pager cleared once day-shift ack.

incident-bot: INCIDENT STATUS -> mitigated. root cause: reserved pool saturation driven by noisy best-effort sessions + autoscaler hitting configured max_nodes (blocked by cloud quota). Severity downgraded P1 -> P2. Tags: [capacity, autoscale, noisy-neighbor, overflow-routing].

alex: Greenpoint acknowleged recovery — "latency normalized after ~10m, acceptable for now but wants RCA and SLA credits reviewed." logged customer follow-up item.

maya: closing oncall handoff: leaving detailed notes in incident doc, will sync with sam for postmortem timeline. action items: quota request, autoscaler improvements, tenant soft-limits, add alert for autoscaler-quota-blocks. thanks all. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: followup reminders set: postmortem draft due in 48h, cloud quota ticket CS-2024-456, support ticket #98765.
